children: Ethereum targets completion of its post-quantum and post-AI transition through the J* upgrade, with the network aiming to reach that milestone in December 2028.

The J* upgrade would change the core cryptography used across the whole Ethereum network. For ETH holders, this network-wide change would be among the most fundamental upgrades in the Ethereum blockchain's history.

title: Ethereum: J* upgrade targets completion of post-quantum and post-AI transition - Dec 2028
